purpose: Compare the XuanTie-E902 communication-reduction proxy GPU gate with a matching single-process CPU repeated-eval loop.
preconditions: XuanTie host probe is built with make -C src/hybrid xuantie_e902_host_probe
reports/xuantie_e902_memory_resident_workload_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time for XuanTie-E902 at the communication-reduction proxy shapes
GPU repeated kernel-launch throughput for XuanTie-E902 at the same gate shapes
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for the first non-TL-UL communication-reduction proxy gate
non_claims: not proof of a true fully resident GPU runtime
not a full RTL application throughput claim
not a broad non-TL-UL generality claim
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: decide whether to implement a true resident runtime path or package the current CPU/GPU boundary
